title: HISTORY MADE IN DOHA: EUROPE’S POLCANOVA AND SZŐCS REACH A WORLD FINAL FOR THE FIRST TIME IN NEARLY HALF A CENTURY
body_html:
On 24 May 2025, Sofia Polcanova and Bernadette Szöcs achieved a remarkable feat at the World Table Tennis Championships in Doha, qualifying for the final of the women’s doubles. Although no specific details of the semi-final were available, this result marks a significant achievement in their careers.

It follows their success in 2024, when Polcanova and Szöcs won silver in the women’s doubles at the European Championships in Linz, losing the final to the Slovak-Czech pair Barbora Balážová and Hana Matelová. At the same championships, Polcanova won gold in the singles, beating Szöcs in the final, and took silver in the mixed doubles with Robert Gardos.

We are therefore proud to announce that the success of ATTP member Sofia Polcanova and of Bernadette Szöcs in 2025 is a golden page in the history of European table tennis and a continuation of fine traditions, highlighting the development and outstanding results of European players on the international stage.
